challenge.name: The Committed Pallets
challenge.description: A supplier has confirmed a bulk order for a middle aisle promotion that ships next week, leaving no room for model error. #requirements_reuben# insists the acceptance criteria must be fully governed to guarantee the allocation logic is auditable before the trucks leave. #reliability_ruth# argues the criteria are sufficient as manual checks because the physical stock is already committed and the team needs to ship the feature immediately to handle the live orders.

output.content: The manual validation of supplier master data before the allocation runs is eating up too much of our cycle time. I want us to automate those data contracts so the checks happen instantly. Every hour we save on manual verification is an hour we can spend refining the allocation logic itself. The more we automate these checks, the faster we can iterate on the feature set and the cleaner the signal becomes for the model. I am not asking for a partial fix. I want the full pipeline to be automated so we can scale this process across all regions without adding headcount. The business goal is clear: reduce the friction between data arrival and model execution to near zero.
output.reclassify_reason: The statement expresses a strong desire to automate the full pipeline to accelerate iteration and scale without headcount, indicating that exceeding the minimum request (full automation) would make the author significantly happier.
